entities.name: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.INITIAL-REGISTRATION-NEEDED
entities.description: A substate of 5GMM-DEREGISTERED where valid subscriber data are available and an initial registration procedure must be performed as soon as possible.

entities.name: Initial registration procedure
entities.description: Registration procedure for initial registration that must be performed when entering the INITIAL-REGISTRATION-NEEDED substate.

entities.name: Access barred due to unified access control
entities.description: Condition where access is barred due to unified access control as specified in subclause 4.5.4.

entities.name: N1 NAS signalling connection establishment rejected
entities.description: Condition where the network rejects the N1 NAS signalling connection establishment.

entities.name: Valid subscriber data available
entities.description: Property indicating that valid subscriber data are available for the UE.

relations.description: The INITIAL-REGISTRATION-NEEDED substate requires performing the initial registration procedure.
The INITIAL-REGISTRATION-NEEDED substate requires that valid subscriber data are available.
Access barred due to unified access control can cause entry into the INITIAL-REGISTRATION-NEEDED substate.
Rejection of N1 NAS signalling connection establishment can cause entry into the INITIAL-REGISTRATION-NEEDED substate.
